description: Saves what the user's points are worth to them, in cents per point, in their saved wallet; every answer then compares cards at those values unless a valuation profile is asked for. No saved cards are needed. Use it when the user says what their points are worth ("I value Chase points at 1.5¢") or that they transfer points to airlines and hotels (profile points-heavy). Values change only the currencies given; null goes back to earnrate's default. Currencies by id: cash (Cash back), MR (Amex Membership Rewards), UR (Chase Ultimate Rewards), sofi-rewards (SoFi Member Rewards), bofa-travel-rewards (Bank of America Travel Rewards points), bofa-premium-rewards (Bank of America Premium Rewards points), usbank-altitude (U.S. Bank Altitude points), navy-federal-rewards (Navy Federal Rewards points), rei-rewards (REI Co-op Mastercard rewards), best-buy-rewards (My Best Buy rewards), C1 (Capital One miles), TYP (Citi ThankYou points), WFR (Wells Fargo Rewards), BILT (Bilt points), united-miles (United MileagePlus miles), aadvantage-miles (American Airlines AAdvantage miles), southwest-rapid-rewards (Southwest Rapid Rewards points), aeroplan (Aeroplan points), atmos-points (Atmos Rewards points), trueblue-points (JetBlue TrueBlue points), ihg-points (IHG One Rewards points), delta-skymiles (Delta SkyMiles), hilton-honors (Hilton Honors points), marriott-bonvoy (Marriott Bonvoy points), kohls-rewards (Kohl's Rewards), nordy-club (Nordy Club points). It uses the wallet file on this computer, not the hosted earnrate connector's wallet.

profile.description: A preset: flat (MR and UR at 1¢) or points-heavy (MR and UR at 1.7¢). Values given too win over it.

values.description: Cents per point by currency id, e.g. {"UR": 1.5, "MR": 1.6}. null goes back to the default.
